Legacy/Behind The Scenes/World Lore/Faun.replace:
35km @ \~20% Load (Max Load of \~180 kilos)  
    * Strain: the share of the Egua's \~900 kg body weight it works against (more weight or more speed, more strain). Up to \~10% all day, \~20% at most.  
      * Carrying on its back: strain = load ÷ 900 kg.  
      * Pulling a cart: strain = (cart + cargo + driver) × road factor ÷ 900 kg. Road factor: 0.05 on a good road, 0.10 on a dirt road, 0.15 in mud or sand.  
      * Distance a day ≈ distance at \~10% × (10% ÷ strain), never more than \~65 km.  
* **Soul Energy Capabilities**
